careers.name: Civil Engineer
careers.description: Designs and builds roads, bridges, dams, water systems and buildings.

careers.name: Electrical / Electronic Engineer
careers.description: Works on power systems, electronics, control systems and telecommunications.

careers.name: Mechanical / Mechatronic Engineer
careers.description: Designs machines, engines, robotics and manufacturing systems.

careers.name: Chemical Engineer
careers.description: Turns raw materials into products at scale - fuels, food, medicines, plastics.

careers.name: Industrial Engineer
careers.description: Makes systems and organisations work better - production lines, logistics, processes.

careers.name: Mining / Metallurgical Engineer
careers.description: Gets minerals out of the ground safely and turns ore into usable metal.

careers.name: Aeronautical Engineer
careers.description: Designs aircraft and the systems that keep them flying.

careers.name: Biomedical Engineer
careers.description: Builds medical devices and the technology used in healthcare.

careers.name: Agricultural Engineer
careers.description: Applies engineering to farming - irrigation, machinery, food systems.

careers.name: Architect
careers.description: Designs buildings and spaces - part art, part engineering.
typicalSubjects: Visual Arts or Engineering Graphics & Design (helpful)

careers.name: Construction & Property Professional
careers.description: Costs, manages and values construction projects and property.

careers.name: Urban & Regional Planner
careers.description: Plans how towns and cities grow - housing, transport, public space.

careers.name: Land Surveyor / Geomatics Professional
careers.description: Measures and maps land, and manages spatial data.

careers.name: Software Engineer / Computer Scientist
careers.description: Designs and builds software systems, applications and infrastructure.
typicalSubjects: Information Technology (if your school offers it)

careers.name: Data Scientist
careers.description: Finds patterns in data and builds models that make predictions.

careers.name: Information Systems / IT Specialist
careers.description: Connects technology to how a business actually runs.

careers.name: Actuary
careers.description: Uses maths and statistics to price risk for insurers, banks and pension funds.

careers.name: Mathematician / Statistician
careers.description: Works on the mathematics behind science, finance and technology.

careers.name: Physicist
careers.description: Studies how the universe works, from particles to stars.

careers.name: Chemist
careers.description: Studies materials and reactions - medicines, fuels, materials, food.

careers.name: Biologist / Biotechnologist
careers.description: Studies living things - genetics, microbes, ecosystems, biotechnology.

careers.name: Geologist / Earth Scientist
careers.description: Studies rocks, minerals and the earth - key to mining and the environment.

careers.name: Environmental Scientist / Ecologist
careers.description: Studies ecosystems and how to protect biodiversity and natural resources.

careers.name: Sport Scientist
careers.description: Works on human performance, fitness and rehabilitation.

careers.name: Doctor (Medicine)
careers.description: Diagnoses and treats illness. Six years of study, then internship and community service.

careers.name: Dentist
careers.description: Treats teeth, gums and the mouth.

careers.name: Pharmacist
careers.description: Dispenses and advises on medicines, in hospitals, pharmacies or industry.

careers.name: Physiotherapist
careers.description: Helps people recover movement after injury, surgery or illness.

careers.name: Occupational Therapist
careers.description: Helps people do the everyday activities that matter to them again.

careers.name: Nurse
careers.description: Front-line patient care in hospitals, clinics and communities.

careers.name: Dietitian
careers.description: Uses nutrition to treat illness and keep people healthy.

careers.name: Optometrist
careers.description: Tests eyes and prescribes glasses, lenses and eye care.

careers.name: Audiologist
careers.description: Tests hearing and treats hearing loss and balance problems.

careers.name: Speech-Language Therapist
careers.description: Helps people with speech, language and swallowing difficulties.

careers.name: Radiographer
careers.description: Produces the medical images - X-rays, scans - used to diagnose illness.

careers.name: Oral Hygienist / Oral Health Practitioner
careers.description: Prevents and treats gum and dental disease alongside dentists.

careers.name: Clinical Associate
careers.description: Works alongside doctors in district hospitals, doing clinical care.

careers.name: Chartered Accountant (CA)
careers.description: Audits, reports on and advises about the money side of organisations.

careers.name: Economist
careers.description: Studies how money, markets and policy shape a country.

careers.name: Financial / Investment Manager
careers.description: Manages money, investments and financial risk for organisations.

careers.name: Business & Management Professional
careers.description: Runs the operations, marketing and strategy side of an organisation.

careers.name: Industrial Psychologist / HR Professional
careers.description: Works on people at work - hiring, wellbeing, performance, organisational design.

careers.name: Lawyer (Attorney / Advocate)
careers.description: Advises on and argues the law - in court, in business or in government.

careers.name: Teacher
careers.description: Teaches in the foundation, intermediate, senior or FET phase.
typicalSubjects: Your teaching subjects at a good level

careers.name: Social Worker
careers.description: Supports individuals, families and communities through crisis and change.

careers.name: Humanities & Social Sciences
careers.description: Broad degrees in languages, politics, psychology, history and media that open many doors.

careers.name: Visual Artist / Designer
careers.description: Fine art, design and visual practice. Most routes need a portfolio.

careers.name: Actor / Musician
careers.description: Drama, music and performance. Most routes need an audition.

careers.name: Digital Arts / Games & Animation
careers.description: Animation, games and interactive media - where art meets code.
